subsystem.name: RuntimeObjectSystem
subsystem.responsibility: Generic runtime objects: menu cursor/scroll widgets, command-dispatch-backed cache holders and state monitors, name-comparison dispatch helpers, parameterized range objects and their constructors, and assorted virtual-dispatch entry points that interact with the global command dispatcher at 0x007CD8C0 and the session-state global 0x007CD25C.

summary: Reconstructs a family of generic runtime/UI objects. A large cluster of methods dispatch integer selectors through a global command-dispatch interface (dword_7CD8C0, vtable slot 28) and either cache the returned object at this+0xE0 or compare it with this via ObjectNameComparison. Two state monitors (0x00478220, 0x004782C0) and one resource monitor (0x00478350) poll an external value, cache it, and notify via this's vtable slot 44. The menu cursor widget group (0x0047BC30, 0x0047BC90, 0x0047BCF0, 0x0047BD90) shares one this object and performs cursor-count, scroll-offset, and scroll-bar-thumb computation over a text source. Sixteen constructors install distinct vtables after calling a shared base initializer (InitVTableSet 0x004668E0 / VtableSetWithInitCall 0x00466980) with two scalar/float range arguments. Remaining functions are assorted virtual-dispatch entries, a conditional string-copy wrapper, and a run-and-maybe-release helper. Owner object types are overwhelmingly UNKNOWN; all groupings are DERIVED or GUESS proposals on top of the function IR.

classes.name: DispatchCacheOwner
classes.responsibility: Methods that dispatch an integer selector through ICommandDispatcher (vtable slot 28 on dword_7CD8C0) and cache the returned object pointer at this+0xE0; all return 0. Each method dispatches a different selector; two (0x004780D0, 0x004781A0) select between two selectors based on session state. Grouping is a structural GUESS; the packet does not prove these six share one concrete type.

classes.name: SelectionStateMonitor
classes.responsibility: Methods that poll an external selection/state value through ICommandDispatcher (slot 28), compare it against the cached value at this+0xE8 and, when changed, update the cache and notify via this's vtable slot 44 with argument 1; both return 0. Field layout (only +0xE8) is shared, but common concrete ownership between the two is a GUESS.

classes.name: ResourceStateMonitor
classes.responsibility: Monitors a resource referenced by the handle at this+0xE0: reads the resource state at resource+0x2C, compares against the cached value at this+0xE4 and, on change, updates the cache, calls ProfileIconPathSetter (0x00478390) and notifies via this's vtable slot 44 with argument 1; returns 0. The +0x254 read is evidenced but its role is unknown.

classes.name: NameComparisonDispatch
classes.responsibility: Methods that dispatch one or two integer selectors through ICommandDispatcher (slot 28 on dword_7CD8C0) and pass each non-null returned object to ObjectNameComparison (0x00477280) with this; the comparison result is discarded and the methods return 0. No this-field access is evidenced, so no fields are declared.

classes.name: MenuCursorWidget
classes.responsibility: Menu cursor/scroll widget: counts wrapped text items and reachable cursor positions over the text pointer at this+0xE0 (fallback global 0x005EA438) using MenuCursorNavigationHelper (0x0047B730), adjusts the scroll offset at this+0xEC within the visible window at this+0xF0, and computes the scroll-bar thumb position at this+0x110 over the track size at this+0x114. Common ownership is strongly evidenced: 0x0047BCF0 calls both 0x0047BC30 and 0x0047BC90 on the same this.

classes.name: ParameterizedRuntimeObject
classes.responsibility: Family of constructors that call a shared base initializer (InitVTableSet 0x004668E0 or VtableSetWithInitCall 0x00466980) with two scalar/float range arguments, install a distinct vtable global, and optionally clear an init/state byte or set an enable byte. Each method installs its own vtable (off_5A4FE0 through off_5A6628), so the concrete types are likely distinct classes; treating them as one family is a GUESS.

classes.name: SubObjectSelector
classes.responsibility: Selects a sub-object pointer at this+0x118 based on a boolean flag at this+0x138, toggling vtable slot 0x3C on this with argument 1 or 0 and returning the sub-object pointer or null; 0x00478EC9 is a trivial getter of the same field. Common ownership between the two is a GUESS.

classes.name: DispatchSequenceObject
classes.responsibility: Entry that clears the dword at this+0x104, dispatches vtable slot 0x40 with argument 0 and vtable slot 0x2C with (this, 1), then returns the result of vtable slot 0x9C. All three dispatch targets are indirect and unresolved.

classes.responsibility: Member helper: invokes 0x00489440 on this, then releases via 0x00587BCF when flag bit 0 of the second argument is set; returns this unchanged. Receiver object and the two wrapper callees are unidentified.

interfaces.name: ICommandDispatcher
interfaces.purpose: Global object at 0x007CD8C0 exposing a virtual lookup at vtable offset 28 (0x1C) that maps an integer selector (14, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26 observed) to a nullable object pointer; the core indirection for command/object retrieval in this subsystem.

interfaces.name: INotifyChange
interfaces.purpose: Virtual callback at vtable offset 44 (0x2C) invoked as (this, 1) on these runtime objects when an externally observed state or selection changes; used by the state/resource monitors and the dispatch-sequence entry. The implementing functions are indirect and unresolved.

compatibility_contracts.name: command_dispatcher_global
compatibility_contracts.description: Global 0x007CD8C0 must remain a pointer to an object whose vtable slot 28 (offset 0x1C) accepts an integer selector and returns a nullable object pointer; thirteen functions in this subsystem dispatch through it with selectors 14-26.

compatibility_contracts.name: session_state_selector
compatibility_contracts.description: Session state at global 0x007CD25C must remain readable via SessionStateCheck (0x00461CD0); state value 3 selects the in-game dispatch opcodes in 0x004780D0 (23) and 0x004781A0 (24).

compatibility_contracts.name: widget_change_notification
compatibility_contracts.description: Runtime/UI objects in this subsystem must expose a vtable slot at offset 44 (0x2C) callable as (this, 1) to signal an externally observed state change; four functions (0x00478220, 0x004782C0, 0x00478350, 0x0047B1B0) rely on it.

compatibility_contracts.name: menu_default_text_global
compatibility_contracts.description: Menu cursor widgets must fall back to the default text source at global 0x005EA438 when the text pointer field at this+0xE0 is null.

unresolved: Identity of the object behind global dword_7CD8C0 and the semantics of its integer selectors (14, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26) are unresolved; only the vtable-slot-28 dispatch pattern is evidenced.
All indirect dispatch targets (vtable slot 28 on dword_7CD8C0; slots 44/0x2C, 0x3C, 0x40, 0x9C, 0xA4 on this) are resolved to no static callee; every virtual call is open.

In 0x00478220 the packet raw source reads the dispatch result at offset +0x174 while the packet field evidence labels the result-object field at obj+0x2C; the two mappings conflict and need deterministic reconciliation before use.

The sixteen constructors each install a distinct vtable global (off_5A4FE0 through off_5A6628); whether they are sixteen distinct classes or variants of one family is unresolved, and the ParameterizedRuntimeObject grouping is a GUESS.
The scalar/float range arguments forwarded to InitVTableSet (0x004668E0) and VtableSetWithInitCall (0x00466980) have semantics owned by those base initializers, outside this packet.
Semantics of the +0x100 and +0x104 flag bytes (enabled vs init state) and of the +0x254 read in 0x00478350 are unknown.
MenuCursorNavigationHelper (0x0047B730) boundary behavior decides whether the cursor/item counts include the final position; that logic is outside this packet.
The UtilityFunction_bd90 tail-call target from 0x0047BCF0 is unevidenced (no callee address in the packet), and the callers of 0x0047BC30/0x0047BCF0 outside the menu path are unknown.
0x0047D060 pairs a VehicleStatsEstimationDisplay call (with global byte_7C56C0) with a vtable+0xA4 dispatch whose receiver and method are both unidentified.
ObjectNameComparison (0x00477280) internals and why its result is discarded by NameComparisonDispatch are unresolved.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc has no address or callee entry in the packet; its location and exact semantics cannot be grounded here.
0x0047E940 is treated as a free function (no this, plain argument a1); its owner class, if any, is unknown.
